QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_6

question.text: Incentive Fees (Performance Fees) for Category III AIFs are generally charged in the range of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook in Section 6.1.1 says incentive fees are charged as a percentage of incremental return generally between 0 and 20 percent. Page 58 of the workbook also describes performance fees as generally up to 20 percent of additional return, while noting managers can charge 0 to 30 percent and most Category III AIFs charge 20 percent. The Trap: A 0-5% range understates the typical charge; 25-35% and a flat 50% lie outside the ranges set out in the workbook. Note: Per workbook pages 56-58 and 168.
